Backend Engineer at Example Fintech Ltd

Posted: Sep 20, 2026

Backend Engineer

Job Summary

Example Fintech Ltd is looking for a backend engineer to build and scale the payment services that power our mobile banking products across West Africa.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain RESTful APIs in Python and Django;
  • Write unit and integration tests and review pull requests
  • Deploy services with Docker and Kubernetes on AWS
  • Monitor production systems with Prometheus and Grafana and fix incidents
  • Integrate payment gateways such as Paystack and Flutterwave

Requirements:

  • B.Sc. in Computer Science or a related field
  • 3 years of experience with Python, PostgreSQL and Redis
  • Good knowledge of ASP.NET or Node.js is an advantage
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions

Benefits

  • Health insurance
  • Remote Fridays

Method of Application

Send your CV to careers@examplefintech.com or call +234 803 123 4567. Visit https://examplefintech.com/careers
